learning.title: Measure 44 px coarse targets in the mobile Playwright project, not a resized desktop browser
learning.trigger: A check or evidence run measures phone touch targets against the 44 px coarse-pointer requirement.
learning.mistake: #406 measured a desktop Chromium resized to 390 px. That is a fine pointer, so the shared --target-min token resolved to 28 px. The shell toggle read 36 px and the select 38 px, and #408 was filed to fix shared parts that were already correct on a coarse pointer.
learning.rule: Run target measurements in the apps/web `mobile` project (iPhone 13 on Chromium; `(pointer: coarse)` matches) and assert `matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches` in the spec. A resized desktop context is valid evidence only for fine-pointer sizing.

verification.requirement: apps/web/tests/machines-touch-targets.spec.ts asserts a 390 px coarse pointer before it measures, and fails if any visible target is under 44 by 44.
